_doc: Paying at the kiosk counter (07/11, Sergio, pointing at the reference game: 'sistema de pagamento assim'): when the player completes an order themselves, the customer pays in cash (cash_share) or by card. The price is already charged on delivery (UMareSimulation::Deliver); this screen is the skill on top: cash -> the player builds the change from the drawer (notes and coins in reais), card -> types the total on the terminal. Exact change: tip_exact of the total and 5 stars; short change: the customer complains (stars_short); too much change: the extra leaves the cash and stars_over. Card typed right: tip_card. Esc lets the customer pay without a tip (stars_skip). The attendant still charges by himself. given: the notes a customer may hand over (the smallest that covers the total, or a bigger one, given_bigger odds).
